caption:
Trump defends Nvidia CEO return

US President Donald Trump revealed he personally intervened to reinstate Jensen Huang as the boss of Nvidia following pressure from the White House and market turbulence. Speaking in an interview with CNBC, the president argued that retaining the tech leader was vital for national stability despite mounting backlash from lawmakers.

The controversial decision comes as Nvidia faces intense scrutiny over national security concerns and export controls, with Huang scheduled to appear before Congress next week. The BBC reported on the dramatic corporate comeback which added almost $1 trillion to the company market value.
